svg.title: astack: from a goal to a merged pull request
svg.desc: Lockup and tagline, then two rows: Goal, Plan, Build, Proof with a turnstile, Review, PR, Harden, Merge with an end-of-proof mark. The return arrow is labelled f compose g. The caption says the composition is an analogy and only the proof parse to admit composition is checked.
svg.text: composition as analogy; only the proof parse→admit composition is checked
